system.description:
Choose the [Passive] effect of this ability or roll a d6. Your next Focused Attack gains the benefits of Flick of the Wrist. If you roll instead of choosing, you gain the [Passive] and [Bonus] effect.

  • 1-2: [Passive] Your range increases by 2. [Bonus] - You deal +2 additional damage.
  • 3-4: [Passive] You deal additional damage equal to Soul. [Bonus] - You gain a +1 to Attack Roll.
  • 5-6: [Passive] You cannot ignore LoS with your attack but it gains a +1 to Attack Roll and a +2 to Base Damage. [Bonus] - You gain a +3 to Base Damage.
